column1: # Hand-labelled gold set for the HN comment parser (JSK-T201). The 30 comments in testdata/hn_comments_golden.json are ANONYMISED SYNTHETIC fixtures written to the documented HN "Who is hiring?" shape ("Company | Role | Location | ..." header, a seeker's post, replies); no real person or company text is kept. Labels were written by reading the fixtures, NOT by running the parser.

# Rules the labels follow (header line only): exactly one of remote/hybrid/onsite named -> that mode; hybrid together with onsite -> hybrid (the stricter claim is the lesser); remote together with onsite or hybrid -> empty (ambiguous, never guessed).
